name: Confiscation Coup
oracle_text: Choose target artifact or creature. You get {E}{E}{E}{E} (four energy counters), then you may pay an amount of {E} equal to that permanent's mana value. If you do, gain control of it.
blocked_sentences: You get {E}{E}{E}{E} (four energy counters), then you may pay an amount of {E} equal to that permanent's mana value.

needs.what: a `may` whose `pay.pay_energy` is a value expression read at resolution (here `mana_value_of` the target t1), fixed to an integer before the affordability check, the way `pay.pay_life` already accepts a value expression (Niv-Mizzet, Ghost Counsel)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Cost.pay_energy is an int in schema.py/carddef.py, so only a printed fixed energy price loads; `pay.times` scales only the mana half of a `may` cost (ops_control.op_may), and `any_amount` lets the player choose the count rather than fixing it to the target's mana value. add_energy and gain_control themselves are already expressible
